text:
lia: smoke bring-up for Nebula-8B-int4 shows drift after ~150 tokens vs fp16 baseline. suspect rotary/head-order packing mismatch in vendor export.

anna: can you paste the tokenizer ids around the drift? BOS/EOS or sentinel placements sometimes sneak into top slots.

sam: same symptom we've seen: stable for ~128 then a steady offset. usually head-interleaving or pack-order. :mag:

lia: minimal repro: run fp16 then int4 and dump logits at step 160.
```python
prompt='Once upon a dataset we noticed...'
toks=tok.encode(prompt)
print(toks[-16:])
# run fp16->save logits@160; run int4->compare
```

kevin: check model.json metadata for rotary packing fields (`rotary_pack`/`rotary_layout`/`rotary_dim`).

lia: model.json: "rotary_pack": "braid", "rotary_dim": 64, "n_heads": 16. Our loader assumes contiguous head-major.

anna: if exporter used braid/interleaved pack we need to remap q/k slices at load. Quick test: reorder heads then compare logits; if it fixes, we keep remap.

sam: run `model-inspector dump-rotary nebula.bin` — it prints `head_map`. Lia?

lia: inspector shows `head_map: [0,8,1,9,2,10,3,11,4,12,5,13,6,14,7,15]`. Loader expected `[0..15]`.

kevin: that interleaving explains the ~half-head delay.

ci-bot: CI: nebula-int4-smoke failed with ppl delta +0.19 at 01:03:22. https://ci.internal/runs/2540

lia: plan: (1) implement load-time remap using detected head_map; (2) add checksum for reshaped weights; (3) add unit test comparing top-1 tokens for first 180 tokens between fp16 and remapped int4; (4) run ngram overlap eval on helpfulness set. ETA EOD.

anna: also add auto-detect: if no explicit map but pattern matches known interleaved signatures, annotate model.json with `rotary_layout: interleaved_half`.

sam: caution: some binaries also reorder qkv grouping (qkv vs qqvvkk). When remapping assert small activation L2 diff <1e-3 on warmup prefix else fail and surface error.

kevin: thumbs up. If patch passes, backport to dedicated runtime release.

lia: will open PR with inspector command, remap snippet, checksum, unit test, CI link. ping here if CI still shows drift. :white_check_mark:
